positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - ASIC verification tools
Senior EDA Tools Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design data management solutions lead for corporate wide microprocessor hardware design kit with focus on physical design

Develop and enhance data management web services and tools interacting with PostgreSQL, MySQL and MSSQL databases in scalable solutions

Build utilities and APIs across source control management solutions such as Perforce

Develop data governance and analytics infrastructure in Fast API for RAG based chatbot to improve design productivity

Delivered central run regression suite for performance and reliability verification

Collaborate with Dev Ops in computing and storage for tool performance improvements

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Develop firmware and software application to evaluate hard disk drive performance and behaviors

Assist all functional groups in firmware code release, debugging, and modifications

Develop graphical user interface for data visualization, and in-depth data analysis using MATLAB®
